## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior.
Link the related issue when one exists.

## Validation

List commands and observed results with the relevant platform/tool versions.
State any unproved part and its reason. Include before/after evidence for UI
changes and scope the evidence to the workflow actually exercised.

## Review

- [ ] The change follows the existing module owners and documented contracts.
- [ ] Public documentation reflects the resulting behavior and contains only public technical information.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO sign-off and preserve the applicable licenses.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the contribution workflow.
